This person owns our channels end to end: the garden3d Substack , our podcast, Instagram, X, and the paid accounts behind them. The ambition runs past marketing a services business. garden3d TK is our young experimental media company, and this role is its engine: books, screenplays, music, media, activations: a record label for ideas. They decide which touchpoints are worth our time, get us there looking like ourselves, and bring back stories worth publishing.
